concerns.text: FR‑001 requires *at least three* public tabular datasets. The plan lists only two verified datasets (UCI HAR and UCI Shopper) and merely flags the shortfall as a spec‑level amendment request without providing a concrete third dataset or an alternative mitigation. This violates the functional requirement and prevents the study from meeting its intended breadth.

FR‑021 specifies a single control‑perturbation dataset created by randomly permuting a fraction of rows in each column. The plan instead creates two distinct controls (full column‑wise permutation for correlation and a 5 % marginal replacement for marginals). This diverges from the specification and undermines the intended false‑positive/false‑negative ground‑truth defined in FR‑022.
